description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.57.html, ticket 3. The 38 panic sites in lib/ and arithmetic_error each raise the exception Elixir raises, with its message: ArithmeticError, ArgumentError (badarg), BadMapError (badmap), KeyError, Enum.EmptyError, Enum.OutOfBoundsError, RuntimeError, and so on. Today they pass atoms, module-name strings, prose or tuples. Checked against elixir's stderr on all three paths.

The oracle fixtures 00617-00639 rescue by Elixir name, but twelve of them (00617, 00618, 00619, 00620, 00621, 00627, 00628, 00630, 00638, 00639, fixtures2/behavior/json_encode_invalid_utf8_key, json_encode_invalid_utf8_value) are silent assertions with no expected.txt, so their expected.stderr is text no Elixir run ever printed. Each becomes a printing oracle: rescue, print Exception.format_banner(:error, e, __STACKTRACE__), expected.txt produced by elixir, expected.stderr the same line. lib/json.fz fails as Elixir's JSON.encode! does, ErlangError with original {:invalid_byte, 255}.

Absorbs fz-sc8.84, the harness check that closes the loop: in tests/fixture_matrix.rs, an expect: abort fixture with an oracle must have an expected.stderr that is non-empty and a substring of its expected.txt, failing with a message naming both files. The check is red on exactly those twelve fixtures until their oracles print, so the check and the rewrite are one commit.
title: The library raises Elixir's exceptions by name
